verdicts.description: One verdict per spec item: S# of the feature document, or A# of the task's own numbered acceptance criteria when there is no feature document.

spec.description: S1, S2, ... (feature document) or A1, A2, ... (the task's numbered acceptance criteria).

verdict.description: unverified counts as unmet; give the reason and the missing command.

evidence.description: Probe and observed result, or the scope reason.

regressionTests.description: Regression tests for the parent to hand to a writer: path, what they cover, and a short reproduction.

reproduction.description: The command and its failing line, one or two lines.

content.description: Full test file; only when the task asks for it.

unverified.description: Checks left unverified, each with the reason and the missing command.
